depiction.primary_object: empty hourglass or sand timer outline
modifiers: circular badge with checkmark at bottom right
depiction.composition: single object in front profile with lower-right corner badge overlay

readings.meaning: time tracking or logged hours approved
screen time limit or app usage quota set

ambiguity: Could be confused with a generic completed task status icon or a plain hourglass/waiting icon if the badge isn't distinguished from the timer concept.
task_intents: verify screen time limits on devices
check whether waiting period has elapsed
confirm Pomodoro timer settings in app
buy sand timer for board games
audit time tracking entries for client

Verify that the 90-day probation period is officially marked complete
Reconcile Harvest time logs against October retainer before invoicing
Confirm the 48-hour escrow hold has cleared with the bank
Test whether oven auto-shutoff timer actually cuts power when done
Double-check that all billable design hours from last sprint are locked and approved
Make sure the 14-day cooling-off period on the solar contract has passed without issues
Configure automatic session timeout to 15 minutes of inactivity on the staging portal

reasoning: Shows an hourglass with a checkmark badge, representing completed timers, approved time tracking/timesheets, screen time limits, or elapsed waiting periods. It fits a clear niche of time-logging and timer tasks, though users must be careful not to apply it to any task that merely mentions a duration or deadline.
